clues: This city sits in the far south of its part of China. It is the last city in the south of that land.
Winters here are long, cold, and dry, while summers are warm and bring most rain. High land cools the air, so January days stay below freezing.
Long ago, this city was known by a name unlike its name today. The old name was dropped, and a new name took its place.
One province wraps round this city on three sides at once. It meets it in the east, in the south, and in the west.
Its famed mount caves are the sign of this place. They sit among the ten most famed caves in all of China.
